theme_rankings.tagline: 🚂 AI의 '밴더빌트' — 실제 업무에 AI 박는 운영자
theme_rankings.why_now: 추론 비용 90% 하락 + 엔터프라이즈 도입 본격. 진짜 텐베거 후보가 여기서 다수.
theme_rankings.risk: 밸류에이션 과열. 매출 성장 30%+ 못 보이면 멀티플 압축.

theme_rankings.why_now: AI가 돌아가려면 전기 필요. 미국 변압기 대기 100주+ → 만드는 회사들 5년치 일감 확보.
theme_rankings.risk: 사이클 후반 진입 우려는 아직 작지만, 금리 급등 시 인프라주 동반 조정.

theme_rankings.why_now: MSFT·GOOG·META·AMZN 2026 Capex 합계 $400B+. AI 매출 회수 본격화 단계.
theme_rankings.risk: 광고·소비 둔화 시 Capex 가이던스 컷 가능. 빅테크 동반 변동성.

theme_rankings.why_now: 인지노동 다음은 물리노동. 2027~2030 진정한 텐베거 가능 영역.
theme_rankings.risk: 상용화 시점 불확실. 미래 옵션밸류 비중 큼. 변동성 극심.

theme_rankings.why_now: HBM4·CoWoS·EUV 모두 캐파 부족 지속. 2027까지 수요 가시성 확보된 영역.
theme_rankings.risk: 사이클 정점 논쟁 + 중국 수출 규제 변동성. 어닝 미스 시 30% 낙폭 흔함.

theme_rankings.why_now: 강한 추세장에서만 사용. 분할매수 + 손절선 명확히 + 자산의 5~10% 이하.
theme_rankings.risk: 장기 보유 ❌. 횡보·하락장에선 음의 복리(volatility decay)로 손실 누적.

top_news.title: EM Asia Stocks Set for Weekly Gain as Markets Regain Footing
top_news.summary: Emerging-market equities in Asia were set for a weekly gain, clawing back some of a recent selloff as investors returned to technology shares and sentiment toward the artificial intelligence trade improved.

top_news.title: Copper Rebounds From 11-Month Low on Return of Risk Appetite
top_news.summary: Copper extended its rebound from an 11-month low alongside technology stocks in Asia, as risk appetite returned across markets after weeks of volatility fueled by concerns over the artificial intelligence trade.

top_news.title: Japan’s ‘Tokyo Drift’ Car Culture Draws Global Fans
top_news.summary:
The latest Japan bucket-list attraction: the world of the Fast & Furious movie franchise.

Japan’s car scene is drawing fans from around the world as tourists flock to see rare Toyota and Nissan models immortalized by the movies. Stefan Nicola has more. (Source: Bloomberg)

top_news.title: Korea Plans Market Meeting as Stock Swings Put Fund in Focus
top_news.summary: South Korean authorities will meet financial industry leaders Monday to assess recent market conditions following the central bank’s rate hike, with the country’s stock market stabilization fund also likely to come up, according to the Financial Services Commission.

top_news.title: Stocks Rise With Nasdaq Futures, Treasuries Fall: Markets Wrap
top_news.summary: Asian stocks gained for a second day along with US equity-index futures, extending a tentative recovery after weeks of volatility in the artificial intelligence trade. Treasuries declined as gains in equities sapped demand for haven assets.

top_news.title: Nifty’s Sharp November Rally Gives India’s IPO Hopefuls a Tailwind
top_news.summary: Firms have raised about $18.6 billion through IPOs this year, with a flurry of deals expected in December.

top_news.title: IMF Sees Emerging Risks in Australia’s $3.1 Trillion of Pensions
top_news.summary: The International Monetary Fund has flagged a series of emerging risks in Australia’s fast-growing pension system, including the challenge of keeping more assets liquid as a wave of workers enters retirement.

top_news.title: How Volatility is Undermining the Carry Trade
top_news.summary: The carry trade, in which investors borrow in currencies like the yen, euro, and dollar, is becoming harder to navigate after delivering strong returns earlier in the year.  Bloomberg's Garfield Reynolds discusses how market changes are impacting the strategy's appeal. (Source: Bloomberg)

top_news.title: IMF Urges RBA to Be Ready to Tighten Further If Prices Worsen
top_news.summary: Australia’s monetary authorities should stand ready to raise interest rates further if price pressures are more persistent, the International Monetary Fund said, while calling on the government to deliver on pledges to tighten fiscal policy.

top_news.title: ‘Dollar Storm:’ Greenback on Track for Longest Winning Run Since 2024
top_news.summary: The dollar is poised for its longest monthly winning streak in two years as a rupture in the artificial intelligence trade and rising interest rates spur demand for safe-haven assets.
